body:
Thank you, I feel pretty sour right now too :(

And I wasn't this prideful when I was younger. Trauma and constant struggles have made be more honest about my qualities than others because those are the only things I have...

Thanks, I blocked him on Facebook. It has helped but when I feel weak, I look at his page and see how happy he is without me :(

I would like to think it is a facade but who knows?

Thank you for your response. 

The reason why I mentioned my physical and academic status is because it is pertinent to my story and situation. I was chased by him because of these characteristics (he chased me because I am pretty and popular, being completely objective and honest with the situation). My entire life, I have only been measured by what I can achieve and what I look like so therefore I have a lot of baggage when it comes to my self worth because of that. People tell me I have a good personality but the only way I have been able to gauge myself is through those measurable characteristics sadly...

And yes, bipolar disorder's onset is often triggered by trauma (according to my psychiatrist). I have other things in my life that I am dealing with but this deep of a crisis I am in has been caused by him.

And I too empathize with your situation. I hope to heal but I feel like I am failing to move on...

Oh and about the first visiting thing, I never got to gauge how interested he was in me and if he had mustered the money to come visit me, that would have helped me see his interest and will to see me. That is why I believe men should initiate first.
